ep9.「――王子君、８周年だと聞きましたよ？」: —Prince, I heard it's the 8th anniversary, is that right?

ep9.「お前が立ち止まらなかったからこその、８周年だ」: It's because you didn't stop that we have this 8th anniversary.
ep9.「これからも、\n王子の目指す未来へ、私たちを連れて行ってくださいね」: From now on, please lead us toward the future you envision.
ep9.「そして今も、助けを求める方々のために、\n幾度も剣をとり、戦い続けてくれていま: And even now, you keep taking up your sword time and again for those who call for help.
ep9.「それでは、椅子から立ち上がったことですし、\nこのまま少し、息抜きに出かけまし: Since you've risen from your seat, why don't we take a little break and go out?
ep9.「それでも、王子は戦うことを選んでくれました」: But still, you chose to fight.
ep9.「でも、こんなお祝いの日にまで、\n執務に励んでいるのはどうかと思います」: But I think it's a bit much to be buried in paperwork on a day like this.
ep9.「はい、起立！ 気をつけ！ 空を見よ！」: Alright, stand up! Watch out! Look to the sky!
ep9.「まぁいい。もう少し近くに来い――そうだ」: Fine. Come a little closer… Ah, that's better.
ep9.「まさか、祝ってほしいのか？」: You want me to celebrate, don't you?
ep9.「存分に誇れ」: Take pride in it to your heart's content.

ep9.「王子の存在は、王国の民にとって、\nかけがえのない誇りです」: Your very presence is an irreplaceable source of pride for the people of the kingdom.
ep9.「王都が陥落したあの日に、\n諦めてしまうことだってできたのに……」: On the day the capital fell, you could have given up…

m110002.―― でーきまーした。\n「統帥の塔」完成ですよー。: ——— It's finally done. The "Tower of Command" is complete!

m110002.――ここが英傑の塔じゃな？\n目の前に見えるのは異界の門かのう。: —Is this the Heroic Tower? The thing ahead looks like a gate to another realm.
m110002.――ふふふ、ようこそ英傑の塔へ。: —Heh heh, welcome to the Heroic Tower.

m110002.――王子君、あなたのご先祖さま、\nそして私達の仲間であった英雄王なんですよ。: —the Prince's ancestors, and the heroic king who was once our comrade.
m110002.――簡単なことです。\n千年戦争の終結から幾星霜。\n私は長い時を、この塔の封印: It's simple. Many ages have passed since the war ended. I've spent a long time sealed within this tower.
m110002.――英傑の塔は、\n２０層が最上階だと思っていましたが……。: —I thought the Heroic Tower's top floor was the 20th level...
m110002.……かつての、敵？\nソラス殿、何故\n白の帝国と王国の関係を知っているのでしょ: ...former enemies? Lord Solais, how do you know about the ties between the White Empire and the Kingdom?
m110002.……これは、過酷ですね。\nまさかこれまでの戦いの情報まで、\nソラス殿に収集さ: ...That's harsh. I never imagined you've gathered all the data from our previous battles, Lord Solais...
m110002.……王子達の力が及ばぬなら、\nここであなたが彼らを蹴散らし、\nこの世界を諦め: …If the Prince's strength can't reach it, you'll drive them away and tell them to abandon this world?
m110002.「統帥結晶」は戦いの記録そのもの。\nこれを使えば、王子ちゃん様の\n神器や武装: A Command Crystal is the battle record itself. Using it, you can enhance your relics and equipment, Your Highness.
m110002.あ、ちょっとうれしそうですね。\nほっぺが緩んでますよ？: Ah, you look a little happy. Your cheeks are all relaxed.

m110002.あらあら、ここで諦めても良いのですよ？: Oh dear, you can give up right here if you like.
m110002.ある種族や職業の方だけ有利に戦えたり、\nその逆もあったりするので、\n次の層に: Some races or jobs will have advantages on certain floors, and the opposite on others—so you'll have to think carefully as you ascend.
m110002.えぇ。英傑の塔は英雄王ちゃん魔術設計、\nソラスちゃん建造の「精鋭を育てる塔」。: Right. The Heroic Tower was designed by the Hero King and built by Solais—a tower to train the elite.
m110002.けれど、ひとまずは休息を。\n戦士には戦うだけでなく、休むことも必要ですからね？: But for now, take a rest. A warrior needs to rest as well as fight, you know?
m110002.けれど、もし『魔王以上の脅威』が迫ったなら……。\nそんな時に備えて、塔が最適な: But if a threat greater than the Demon King ever arises... I've arranged for the tower to self-expand into the optimal form for such a situation.
m110002.さて、それは王子君たちの実力次第♪\nそのための英傑の塔、というわけですからね。: Well, that depends on the Prince's abilities ♪ That's why we have the Heroic Tower, after all.
m110002.さて。ここは王子君を鍛錬するための場所ですから、\n私としても手加減することはで: Now then. This place is meant to train you, Prince, so I won't hold back. If you're going to give up, now's the time, okay?
m110002.そうそう。その光に触れている間は、\n特別な加護を受けることができますよ。\n上: Exactly. While you touch that light, you'll receive a special blessing. Make good use of it.
m110002.それから、王子ちゃんにも良いことがありますよぉ？\n統帥の塔内での戦いは記録され: Also, Prince, there's a perk for you! Battles inside the Tower are recorded and turned into "Command Crystals."
m110002.それから、統帥の塔は訓練施設ですからねぇ。\nより厳しい状況を乗り越えるほど、\: And since it's a training facility, the tougher the conditions you overcome, the higher your score on each floor.
m110002.それじゃあ王子ちゃん、\nさっそく統帥の塔に挑んでみてくださいねぇ♪: So, Prince, go ahead and give the Tower of Command a try! ♪
m110002.それでは、どうぞ、英傑の塔へ――。: Now then, please, proceed to the Heroic Tower—.
m110002.それでは王子君、これまでの戦いの道程と、\n自分と、それに匹敵する好敵手の映し身: Now then, Prince, face the path of your past battles and a mirror image of a worthy opponent equal to you. Defeat it splendidly...!
m110002.それでは２１層の試練を起動しますよ！\n王子君、戦闘準備をお願いします！: Then we'll activate the 21st-floor trial! Prince, prepare for battle!
m110002.ですからまずは、その過程で収集した情報から、\n最初の試練を与えることにしましょ: So, based on the information I've gathered, let's start with the first trial. Your opponent will be—
m110002.でもこれだけでは物足りませんよね……。\nここはひとつ、天使に、デーモンに……。: But that's not enough, is it... Let's throw in an angel, a demon...—that'll do, ♪
m110002.とうすいの、とう……？\n英傑の塔とは違うのか？: Wait, what? Is this different from the Heroic Tower?
m110002.なので、そんな軍の皆さんが、\nはばひろーく訓練できるように、\n各層ごとに色ん: So we've set up different conditions on each floor so everyone can train as broadly as possible.
m110002.なるほど……。\nならば、この塔に入る資格があると認めましょう。: I see… Then I'll acknowledge that you have the right to enter this tower.
m110002.なるほどな……。\nあいつが王子を助けようとしてくれてるってことか。: I see… so he's trying to help the Prince.
m110002.なれば、王子君達に\nその実力の片鱗だけでも見いだせなければ、\nここで諦めるよ: So, unless we can find even a glimpse of your power, Prince, it's our duty as those before you to counsel you to give up here.
m110002.はい♪ お人好しはご先祖様譲りですね、王子君♪: Yes♪ Kindness runs in your ancestors, Prince♪
m110002.はいはい。\n――では統帥の塔の説明をしますねー。: Right, right. Now, let me explain the Tower of Command.

m110002.ふふ、やはり。\nあなたなら、かの魔王を\n滅ぼすことがかなうかもしれませんね。: Heh, as I thought. You might actually be able to defeat that Demon King.
m110002.ふふふ、かつての敵からも信頼が厚いとは、\nそういうところもあの人にそっくりです: Heh, even former foes hold you in such high regard—just like that other person.
m110002.ふふふ、さすがに塔が\n自分でそこまで判断はしませんよ♪: Heh, even the tower wouldn't make that kind of judgment on its own♪

m110002.ふむ……。\n塔に入るには相応の実力を見せよ、というわけじゃな。\n王子よ、油断: Hmm… To enter, you must show appropriate strength, that's the idea. Prince, don't let your guard down.
m110002.ふん、上等だ。\nさぁ王子、英雄王にお前の実力を見せてやろうぜ！: Hmph, not bad. Come on, Prince, let's show the Heroic King what you're capable of!
m110002.まぁ、新しい修行の場が増えるのは良いことだけどな。\nそれより、塔なんかに\nお: Well, more training grounds can't be a bad thing. But more than that, I won't stand for the tower saying I'm not strong enough.
m110002.まずは王子君と、王子君が信じる仲間達が、\nこの塔に入るだけの資格があるかどうか: First, Prince, and the comrades you trust, we'll determine whether you're worthy to enter this tower—myself and the tower's guardians will judge.
m110002.よろしい。\n狭間より現れる守護者と、私の魔術。\n見事退け、実力を見せてくださ: Very well. Defeat the guardians that emerge from the limbo and my sorcery. Show us your prowess!
m110002.わぁ……足場が浮いています……！\n魔界とも物質界とも違う、不思議な感じです……: Wow… the ground is floating! It feels strange, unlike either the demon realm or the material world!
m110002.シャディアちゃんは相変わらず心配性ですねぇ。\n何も自分の興味本位で、\nこんな: Shadia-chan, you're as worry-prone as ever. It wasn't built out of my own curiosity, you know?
m110002.ワシらを見くびっては困る。\nこれより過酷な戦場はいくつもあったぞい。: Don't underestimate us. There have been many harsher battlefields than this.
m110002.今の私達では、天界の異変に対抗できないと……。\nそれで突然、２１層に続く階段が: With our current strength, we can't oppose the celestial disturbance… So that's why a staircase to the 21st floor suddenly appeared.

m110002.具体的には、少人数で突破するほど、\nスコアがよくなる仕組みにしておきました。\: Specifically, the fewer troops you use to clear a floor, the better your score. Once you get the hang of it, try using even smaller squads.
m110002.塔が起動するまで身動きは取れませんでしたが、\nずっと、この世界を見守り続けてい: I couldn't move until the tower reactivated, but I've been watching over this world all along—your two nations' conflict as well.

m110002.異界の門を知っているなんて、\n当代の魔術師も捨てたものではなさそうですね。\n: Knowing about a gate to another world—seems even modern magicians haven't discarded that knowledge. In that it's a liminal space connecting elsewhere, it's similar.
m110002.私は彼の未来を想う願いを再現できるように、\nこの塔を設計したに過ぎませんからね: I only designed this tower so I could recreate the wish to protect his future!
m110002.私もそのつもりでしたよ？\n２０層まで上り詰めれば、魔王ガリウスに\n対抗できる: I thought the same. I believed that reaching the 20th floor would grant us the power to stand against Demon King Garius.
m110002.私達も、あの魔王を真に滅ぼすことは出来ませんでした。\nただアイギス様のお力を借: We couldn't truly vanquish that Demon King ourselves. All we did was borrow Aegis's power to seal him temporarily, pushing the problem into the future.
m110002.統帥の塔は、アンブローズ様がど忘れして、\n私ごと、ざっと千年放置した\n王国大: The Tower of Command is something Ambrose forgot about, and I left it alone for a thousand years, inheriting the philosophy of the Great Kingdom Labyrinth.
m110002.統帥の塔は、様々な状況下で訓練を積む装置、\nというかつての迷宮の思想を反映した: The Tower of Command is a training device for various situations—a facility that reflects the old labyrinth's ideas and strengthens the entire army.
m110002.英傑の塔の意思というべきもの。\n次代の英雄にあらゆる智慧と武技を授けんと、\n: You could call it the will of the Heroic Tower. It wove a management magic to grant the next generation of heroes all the wisdom and martial skill they need, to spur their growth—

m400418.穏健派の竜人たちとは違い、「黒き長老」含むその一族の\n竜人たちは戦闘行為を好む: Unlike the moderate draconians, the clan that includes the Black Elder enjoys combat, so a diplomatic solution is impossible. In other words, we have to fight.
m400418.自軍の被害を抑えるよりも、\nいかに多くの敵を倒すかが重要なんです。: Rather than minimizing your own losses, the key is how many foes you can slay.
m400418.良かった……。戦ってくださるのですね。\n流石はお人よし王じ……ゴホンゴホン。:
That's good… You're willing to fight.
As expected of a kind-hearted prince… *cough cough*

m400509.――王国近海にゴブリン軍団、ですか……。: ――Goblin hordes near the kingdom's coast, huh…
m400509.……捕縛が優先だ。\n犯罪者相手に犯罪をしてどうする。\nもちろんEXPもゴール: …Capturing them takes priority. What good is committing a crime against criminals? We won't get any EXP or gold anyway.
m400509.ああ。\n今朝から怪しい動きを見せている。: Yeah. They've been acting suspiciously since this morning.
m400509.うむ、私掠船団の協力は心強い。\n安心して敵戦力を削ることに集中できるな。: Yes, having the privateer fleet's support is reassuring. We can concentrate on cutting down enemy forces without worry.
m400509.うむ。\nなので潜水騎士に手伝ってもらって、\nゴブリン軍団の調査をしてみたとこ: Right. So we asked the Submarine Knights to help investigate the goblin horde, and—
m400509.ぐぬぬぬぬ。\n私掠船なのにー、王子クンの許可とってるのにー。: Grrr… Even though we're a privateer fleet—and have your permission, Prince…
m400509.ここは『大討伐ミッション』を発令し、\n一体でも多くの敵戦力を\n削る編成を重視: I recommend issuing a “Grand Annihilation Mission” and focusing on a lineup that whittles down as many enemy units as possible.
m400509.ここはこちらも軍を出し、\n明確に意志を問うべきでしょう。: We should also deploy troops and demand a clear answer.
m400509.そいつはよくないなぁ……。\n海であれ森であれ、\n漁場の所有権は王子クンにある: That's not good… Whether it's the sea or the forest, the fishing rights belong to you, Prince.
m400509.ただ、海上では普段と同じ効率での補給は望めない。\n出撃コストは回復しないから、: However, we can't expect the usual supply efficiency at sea. Since sortie costs don't recover, we should bring “Reinforcement Requests” and units like Valkyries.
m400509.つまり、ライフが０になってもクリアになるし、\n味方の被害は心配しなくていいって: In other words, even if our HP hits zero we still clear the stage, so you don't have to worry about friendly casualties!
m400509.で、相手が密漁ゴブリンだったら、\nもちろんお宝ぶん捕っていいんだよね？: So, if the opponents are poaching goblins, we can of course seize the treasure, right?
m400509.よし。編成は王子に任せる。\nただ、連中の頭数はかなりのものだ。: All right. I'll leave the formation to you, Prince. Just know they're a sizable force.
m400509.ゴブリンにはそういう文化がない可能性もある。\n正式に抗議して、それで聞いてくれ: Goblins might just not have that kind of culture. If a formal protest doesn't work, maybe we should give them a good blast?
m400509.ゴブリン軍団は物質界連合の一員ではありますが、\n未だ、解散後には敵対すると公言: Goblins are part of the Material Realm Alliance, but they've openly declared that they'll turn hostile after the dissolution—so they're a potential enemy force.
m400509.メカゴブリンクイーンの配下を騙る、\n別勢力のゴブリンである可能性もあります。: There's a chance these are goblins from another faction posing as Mecha-Goblin Queen's subordinates.
m400509.戦闘になっても、現場は私たちの縄張りだ。\n船団で囲んで、負傷者はしっかり回収す: Even once combat starts, this is still our territory. We'll encircle them with our fleet and make sure any wounded are properly rescued.
m400509.海上演習を王国領内でするつもりなら、\n正式に届け出をしろと伝えてみたが、\nこ: I told them that if they plan to conduct naval exercises within kingdom waters, they need to file an official report, but they keep insisting they're just anchored.
m400509.軍事行動と略奪を一緒にするな、まったく。\n――よし、それじゃあ各員出撃の準備を:
Don't mix combat with looting, honestly.
—Alright then, everyone, prepare to deploy.
The "Grand Subjugation Mission" begins!

m400582.――そろそろ、ハロウィンの祝祭が始まりますね。: ――It's about time the Halloween festivities begin.
m400582.――大変です王子！\n突如としてチェーンソーを振り回す怪物たちが現れ、\n仮装を:
――Prince, this is bad!
Monsters wielding chainsaws have suddenly appeared,
and they're rampaging through the venue along with the costumed villagers!!
m400582.『大討伐ミッション』は、\n一体でも多くの敵を倒す事が目的です。:
The objective of a "Grand Cull Mission" is
to defeat as many enemies as possible.
m400582.あっ、飾りといえばね、\n実はレミィとクーコも会場の準備を手伝ってくれたの！:
Oh, and speaking of decorations,
Remi and Kouko actually helped with the venue preparations too!
m400582.あの様子は精神支配されていますわ！\n村人たちが被っている仮面には、\n着けた者:
They appear to be under mental domination!
The masks the villagers are wearing
seem to have an effect that drives the wearer into a frenzy!
m400582.そういえば、ちらっと見ましたけど、\nカボチャの飾りとか可愛くできてましたね。:
Speaking of which, I caught a glimpse earlier.
The pumpkin decorations you made were adorable.
m400582.でしたら、今から見に行きましょうか。\nちょうどハロウィンが始まる時間です。\n:
Then, let's go take a look.
It's just about time for Halloween to start.
Look, beyond the window, the villagers are enjoying the festivities……
m400582.とはいえ、ハロウィン会場には人が大勢集まっており、\n普段のような部隊展開を行う:
That said, since a large crowd has gathered at the Halloween venue,
it will be difficult to deploy units as usual.
m400582.なんにせよ、この騒動をどうにかしないと、\nハロウィンを楽しめないわよ！\nさっ:
Regardless, we have to deal with this commotion,
or we won't be able to enjoy Halloween!
Let's go, Prince!
m400582.ほ、本当！？ 何回も練習し――こほんっ！\n私は手先だって器用なんだから、あれく:
R-Really?! I practiced so many times, but― cough!
I'm quite dexterous with my hands, you know. That was a piece of cake for me!
m400582.もうすっごいんだから！\n王子にも今すぐ見てもらいたいくらい！:
They did an amazing job!
I want the Prince to see them right now!
m400582.今日に向けて衣裳も用意して、\n村の人たちと会場の飾りつけも頑張ったわ。\nきっ:
I prepared the costumes for today, and I really worked hard on decorating the venue with the villagers.
I'm sure it's going to be a wonderful Halloween♪
m400582.出撃されるのですね、王子。\nですがその前に、今回のミッションは、\n敵の討伐を:
Very well, Prince. You are deploying.
However, before that, please note that this operation is a
"Grand Cull Mission," aimed at eliminating the enemies.
m400582.出撃コストが時間経過では回復しないため、\nスキル『援軍要請』を持つメンバーや、:
Because deployment cost does not recover over time,
I recommend including members with the "Reinforcement Request" skill,
or Valkyries, in your formation.
m400582.嘘でしょ……きゃぁーー！？\n頑張って作った飾りつけが破壊されてるじゃない！？:
No way…… Aaaah!?
They're destroying the decorations I worked so hard on!?
m400582.拠点のライフが0になった場合でも、\nそれまでの討伐数が記録として残りますので、:
Even if the base's life reaches zero,
the number of enemies defeated up to that point will be recorded,
so do not fear falling; stand against the enemy.
m400582.窓から見える範囲で、暴れているのは……。\n怪物の仮面を被っている村人……！？\:
From what I can see out the window, the ones rampaging are……
Villagers wearing monster masks……!?
What on earth is happening…….

m500510.――あな、たは――ゆに、こー、ん？\nそう――ですか――では、\nいまのじだいの:
――You…… are…… unique……?
I see…… then……
The humans of this era……
m500510.――そう、古の巨大兵器、\n成長し続ける機械なんじゃないかって言われてる。:
――yes, it's an ancient super-weapon,
a machine that keeps growing and evolving.
m500510.――人類が――なぜ、私を――\n私は――人類の、守護者で――あれ――と――:
――Humanity…… why…… me……
I am…… humanity's…… guardian…… but…… and……
m500510.――再起動シークエンス開始。\n再起動シークエンス開始。\n機関始動――カウント:
――Reboot sequence initiated.
Reboot sequence initiated.
Engine startup――countdown initiated――
m500510.――無事に侵入できたが、\nこれはいったい、どうなっているんだ……？:
We've infiltrated without incident, but……
what on earth is going on here……?
m500510.――至上命令を遂行します。\n人類に栄光を、人類に平和を、永遠の時代を。:
――Executing supreme directive.
Glory to humanity, peace to humanity, an eternal era.
--- scene: Lv.10 (battle, end) ---
m500510.――警報。侵入者を確認。\nコアユニットにバリアシステムを展開。\nバリアシステ:
――Alert. Intruder detected.
Deploying barrier system around the core unit.
Barrier system linked units are operating normally.
m500510.……今は、お眠りなさい。\nあなたが必要とされる時代は、まだ来ていません。:
……Please, rest now.
The era when you are needed has not yet arrived.
m500510.……間違いありません。\nデミウルゴスの名が、ここに書かれています。:
……There's no mistaking it.
The name of Demorgos is written right here.
m500510.あ、あの、気になることというか、\n心当たりがあります！:
Ah, um, there's something I'm curious about,
and I have a hunch!
m500510.ああ、無事に戻ってきた。\nどうやら休眠期間中であれば、\n内部に侵入することが:
Yes, he returned safely.
It seems that during its dormancy period,
it is possible to breach the interior.
m500510.ああ。異様に巨大な機械の塊が、\n鋼の都との定期航路上で発見された。:
That's right. An abnormally massive mechanical structure was discovered
on the regular shipping route to the Steel Capital.
m500510.あとは……仮でも良いので、\n巨大機械に何か名称を――:
And then…… even if it's just a placeholder,
we should give the colossal machine some name――
m500510.あの触手みたいなやつか！\nあれを壊せばいいってことね！:
Those tentacle-like things!
So we just need to destroy them, right?
m500510.いえ、確かに強力な存在ではあるのですが……。: No, it is certainly a formidable entity, but…….
m500510.いえ、私の計器の故障を一瞬疑ってしまって……。\nというのも、その巨大な機械は―:
I'm sorry, I briefly suspected my instruments were malfunctioning……
You see, that colossal machine is――growing.
m500510.えぇ、これは、私ですら焼き尽くせなかった、\nいつの時代からあるかも分からない、:
Yes. This is a mechanical lifeform that has existed for an unknown age,
one that I could not burn to ashes,
and which continues to replicate infinitely.
m500510.えっ、わっ、待って！\n変なスイッチ押したりしてないからね！？:
W-Wha, wait!
You didn't press any weird switches, did you!?
m500510.お、王子！ 大変です！\n近隣の漁師たちが、\n魚を持って押しかけてきました！:
P-Prince! It's urgent!
The local fishermen
have barged in here carrying fish!
m500510.おそらく、デミウルゴスの異様な耐久性能の原因です。\n周囲に展開されている小型ユ:
It's likely the source of Demigorgos's abnormal durability.
The small units deployed around it are resonating,
strengthening the barrier!
m500510.これはもしかしたら、\n古の超巨大兵器――\nデミウルゴスかもしれません！:
This might just be
an ancient super-weapon――
Demorgos!
m500510.さて、敵は未知の魔神だ。\n気を抜くな！ 総員攻撃開始！！:
Now then. The enemy is an unknown demon god.
Don't let your guard down!
All units, commence attack!!
m500510.さらには、こちらからの砲撃は全くの無意味。\n装甲を傷つける程度が限界だった。:
Furthermore, our artillery fire was completely useless.
We could barely scratch its armor.
m500510.それから王子、兵たちが言葉を待って――: And, Prince, the soldiers are waiting to hear what you have to say—
m500510.それが無難かと思います。\n大火力をもってすれば、\n直接バリアを砕くことも可能:
That seems like the safest approach.
If we use enough firepower,
we might be able to shatter the barrier directly, but……
m500510.ただ、この個体はこれまでのものに比べて\n遥かに巨大な姿をしています。\nおそら:
Still, this individual is far more massive than the previous ones.
It's likely close to the core.
m500510.ただ、この子自身が、\nその莫大な増殖能力ゆえに危険視され、\n遥かな過去に封印:
However, this one itself was viewed as a danger
due to its immense reproductive capability,
and was sealed away in the distant past……
m500510.ですね……。\nでは、調査が一段落したら、破壊作業に――:
I agree…….
Then, once the investigation is done, we'll begin the destruction――
m500510.では、ひとまず勝利ということだな。\n一時はどうなることかと思ったが。:
Well, that's a victory for now, I suppose.
I thought things were going to go south there for a moment.
m500510.では、彼らもまじえて\n戦勝記念パーティを開きましょうか。:
Then let's include them
and throw a victory party.
m500510.では、決まりだな。\n討伐部隊を編成し、内部に侵入、\nその後に巨大機械の破壊を:
Then it's settled.
We will form an assault unit, infiltrate the interior,
and then proceed to destroy the colossal machine.
m500510.でも、今の時代の人類を知って、\n安心したみたいです。:
But it seems relieved
after learning about the humans of this era.
m500510.どうやら休眠期間が終わったらしい。\n最初から破壊するつもりだったんだ、\n総員:
It seems its dormant period has ended.
It was designed to be destroyed from the start.
All units, prepare for battle!
m500510.どーんぶりんがー、ずばーんってしたら？: How about we just blast it to smithereens?
m500510.は、はいっ！\nえっと……制御盤ですか？\n刻まれている名称が、これは……。:
Y-Yes!
Um…… is that a control panel?
The name engraved on it is…… this is…….
m500510.ば、ばりあとか言ってるけど！？: B-Barrier? What does that even mean!?
m500510.まぁ、理論上は……？\n生物と同じように、構成部品の材料を\n取り込めるなら、自:
Well, theoretically……?
If it can absorb materials from its constituent parts
just like a living organism, it can keep modifying itself.
m500510.まったく、いつの時代の奴か知らないが、\n厄介な遺産を残してくれたものだな。:
Honestly, I don't know what era it's from, but
it sure left us a troublesome legacy.
m500510.ん、どうしたの？\n口ごもるだなんて、らしくない。:
Hmm, what's wrong?
Hesitating like that isn't like you.
m500510.コアの位置も探さないとね。\nそれから、ここの残骸もできれば調査したい！:
We still need to locate the core.
Also, I'd like to investigate the wreckage here if possible!
m500510.コア部分の暴走は止まっていませんが、\nしばらくは休眠状態になるはずです。:
The core's runaway state hasn't stopped,
but it should enter a dormant state for a while.
m500510.デミウルゴス……。\n昔話の異形の怪物ですよね？\nそれから、くぐつ使いの間では:
Demorgos…….
That monster from the old tales, right?
And among the spirit users, it's said that――
m500510.デミウルゴスの自壊を見て、\n喜び勇んで駆けつけてきたな？:
They saw Demigorgos self-destruct
and rushed over in a frenzy of joy?
m500510.上空からも確認しましたが、\n確かに巨大な機械が存在しました。そのうえ……。:
I confirmed it from the air as well.
There is indeed a colossal machine there. And on top of that……
m500510.人類を――この星を――\n愛すべき――もの、たち、を――:
Humanity…… this planet……
The things…… that should be…… loved……
m500510.今この場にあるものも、\n果たして本体なのかどうか……。:
As for what's here now,
I don't even know if it's the main body…….
m500510.任せて、当たりを引くのは得意だから――っと。\nおーい、レーヴ！ こっちきて！:
Leave it to me. I'm great at finding the right one――there.
Hey, Reve! Come over here!
m500510.何か、ご存知みたいですね？: You seem to know something about it?
m500510.何か吹っ切れたというか、\n覚悟を決めたような顔つきだが……。:
You look like you've just made up your mind,
like you've finally resolved yourself……
m500510.何にせよ、放置すれば\n際限なく増殖し続けるのであれば、\nここで破壊する以外の:
Either way, if we leave it alone,
it will keep multiplying without limit.
We have no choice but to destroy it here.
m500510.全く反撃がないのが不気味だねぇ。\nともあれ、今のうちに調査しちゃおう。\n破壊:
It's creepy that there's been no counterattack at all.
Anyway, let's investigate while we can.
If we destroy it, we won't be able to examine it!
m500510.動力機関がどこにあるのか……。\nうぅぅぅ、うずうずするぅぅぅ。:
Where is the power source……
Uuuu, I can't sit still……
m500510.商船団からの報告によれば、\n元々は漁師が休憩に立ち寄る、\n小さな無人島があっ:
According to reports from the merchant fleet,
that location used to be a small uninhabited island
where fishermen would stop to rest.
m500510.変なスイッチとか触らないようにねー。: Just don't touch any weird switches, okay?
m500510.守護者……？\n君は、何かを守るために創られたのかい？:
Guardian……?
Were you created to protect something?
m500510.少しだけ、記憶領域に接続できました。\nおそらくこの子は、\n世界の危機に備えて:
I was able to connect to its memory sector for a brief moment.
This one was likely created
to prepare for a crisis in the world.
m500510.幸い、糸口は掴んでいる。\n命知らずの漁師が接舷して、内部に入ってみたらしい。:
Fortunately, we have a lead.
A reckless fisherman boarded the machine and managed to get inside.
m500510.標的の規模から考えて、\n対魔神戦と同規模の部隊編成が必要だろう。\n人選は王子:
Given the scale of the target,
we will need a unit of the same size as for a Demon God battle.
I leave the personnel selection to you, Prince.
m500510.機械が、成長……？\nそんなことがありえるのでしょうか。:
A machine, growing……?
Is that even possible?
m500510.王子、此度の討伐、お疲れ様でした！: Well done, Prince, on this subjugation!
m500510.現時点ではそれは危険かと。\n地表付近での主砲発射は、\n周辺環境にどんな影響を:
That would be dangerous at this point.
Firing the main guns near the surface could have
unpredictable effects on the surrounding environment……
m500510.私が対処できなかった最大の理由は、\nその核となるユニットが、\nどこにあるのか:
The main reason I couldn't deal with it was that
I had absolutely no idea where its core unit was located.
m500510.自己増殖し続ける、巨大な機械……。\n王子、このまま放置し続けるのは、危険かと思:
A colossal machine that continues to self-replicate……
Prince, I believe it would be dangerous to leave this unattended.
m500510.自己増殖し続ける機械、\n強靭な装甲、そして目撃者の証言……。:
A machine that continues to self-replicate,
tough armor, and the eyewitness accounts……
m500510.見たことのない形式だ……。\n配線が機械っていうより生物に近いよ。:
This configuration is unlike anything I've seen…….
The wiring looks less like machinery and more like living tissue.
m500510.誰もが平和を願っています。\nそして栄光を掴み取らんと、努力しています。\n永遠:
Everyone wishes for peace.
And they strive to seize glory.
It's far from eternal, but still.
m500510.調査に派遣した軍艦が、\n件の機械から攻撃を受けた。:
The warship we dispatched for investigation
was attacked by the machine in question.
m500510.超古代文明の遺産を焼き尽くしてきたプロメが……？\nそれだけ強力な存在ということ:
Prome, who has burned through the relics of a hyper-ancient civilization……?
So that means it's that powerful?
m500510.（――あなたが、その例外でないことを願います）: (—I hope you are not one of those exceptions)
m500510.（――いずれ人類の中から現れる、\n自らを滅ぼす、例外を排除する、こ、と――）:
(—and to exclude the exceptions
that arise from humanity and seek its own destruction—)
m500510.（――ひとを、みちびくもの――\nこの時代の――王たるものよ――）:
(—the one who guides the people—
O king of this era—)
m500510.（わたしの、使命は――\n敵を――はいじょ、し、世界を、まもること――）:
(My mission is—
to eliminate the enemy and protect the world—)

m500527.――ここまで攻め込むとは、\nさすがは皇帝……いや、皇帝陛下と言うべきか。:
—To push this far into our lines…
Truly, the Emperor… or rather, His Imperial Majesty, lives up to his name.
m500527.――すると、どうなるか分かるか？: So, do you see where this leads?
m500527.――双方、準備はよろしいですか？\n立会人は、王国軍より私、ケイティが務めます。:
—Are both sides ready?
I, Katie, of the Royal Army, will serve as the referee.
m500527.……やはり、抜け目のない男だな。\nこの要塞を見るだけで分かる。\nベラートめは:
……He really is a shrewd one.
Just looking at this fortress tells you that much.
Belart must have been preparing for this long before the war with the Netherworld Army.
m500527.あちらの観戦席を見てみよ。: Look at the viewing stands over there.
m500527.あっ！ ベラートさまの巨大砲台だ！\nあの砲台ね、パパが作ったんだよ！:
Oh! It's Lord Belart's giant cannon!
That cannon, Dad built it!
m500527.いや、いい戦いだった。\nベラドンナ……いや、ベラドンナ伯爵、\nその指揮官とし:
No, it was a fine battle.
Belladonna… or rather, Countess Belladonna,
I'd like to have a commander of your caliber in the Imperial Army.
m500527.いや、私を巻き込まないでくれ。\nそれに、我が部族はもう次に備えている。:
No, please don't drag me into this.
Besides, my tribe is already preparing for what comes next.
m500527.いやいや、素晴らしい仕事です。\nかくいう私も砲弾を納品しておりましてな。:
Oh, don't be so modest. That's splendid work.
As it happens, I was the one who supplied the cannonballs.
m500527.うおー！！\nベラート様ー！ この腹黒元領主ー！！:
Whoa—!
Lord Belart—!
Our scheming former lord—!
m500527.うむ。やはり帝国軍はすごかった、\nしかしそこに一矢報いるベラドンナ伯爵は、\n:
Yes. I want them to think, “The Imperial Army is indeed formidable,
but Countess Belladonna struck back with honor—
she truly is a worthy lord of our land.”
m500527.うむうむ、良い心がけだ。\n――さて、では準備を始めるとするか。:
Mm-hm, good attitude.
—Well then, let's begin our preparations.
m500527.えぇ、皆さま準備をよろしくお願いします。: Yes, I'll leave the preparations to everyone.
m500527.えぇ。もとより伯爵領は交通の要所であり、\n一大交易拠点。いわば帝国の大動脈。:
Yes. The county has always been a key transportation hub,
a major trading post. You could say it's the empire's main artery.
m500527.えぇ父様。\nそれにしても、このような要塞の晴れ舞台、\n父様自ら指揮をお取りに:
Yes, Father.
Still, for a debut of a fortress like this,
wouldn't it be better if you took command yourself?
m500527.おぉ、それはそれは！\nでは共に、あの最強の砲台を応援しましょう！:
Oh, I see!
Then let's cheer for that most powerful cannon together!
m500527.おぉー、ここが噂に名高いベラート要塞！: Oh wow, so this is the legendary Belart Fortress!
m500527.こ、こらっ。\nいやすみませんね娘が。\n私はただ、あの砲台の歯車を担当しただけ:
N-now!
I apologize for my daughter.
I was only in charge of the gears for that cannon.
m500527.こちらも腕利きの料理人を揃えました。\n伯爵領名物の数々、楽しんでいってください:
We've also assembled a team of top chefs.
Please enjoy the famous specialties of the Count's territory.
m500527.この一戦は、伯爵領が今後の帝国で、\nどれだけの発言力を持つかを占うものとなる。:
This battle will determine how much influence
the county will hold in the empire going forward.
m500527.さぁ帝国軍よ！\n湯水のように金を注ぎ込んだこの最強兵器！\nその威力、身を持っ:
Now then, Imperial Army!
Behold this ultimate weapon, into which we poured gold like water!
Feel its power with your own bodies!!
m500527.さすれば、帝国が強くなるほど伯爵領の名も上がり、\nなおかつ皇帝はお前を無視でき:
That way, the stronger the empire becomes, the higher the county's name rises.
And the Emperor will no longer be able to ignore you.
m500527.さて、演習が終わったのなら、\n双方の兵のために、慰労が必要ですわね。:
Now that the exercise is over,
we must hold a celebration for the soldiers on both sides.
m500527.しかぁし！\nベラート要塞が最強たる所以はここにあり！:
But!
The reason Belart Fortress is the strongest is right here!
m500527.その交易によって得た有り余る財を、\nこうした防衛設備に注ぎ込んでいたのでしょう:
He likely poured the surplus wealth from that trade
into defensive infrastructure like this.
m500527.その意気やよし！\nさぁ、皆のもの！ このベラートが出るぞぉぉぉッ！！:
Now that's the spirit!
Come on, everyone! It's time for this Belart to show you what he's made of!
m500527.だから自己顕示欲ぅ！！: That's what I mean about the ego trip!!
m500527.ちなみに同じ名前の建築物が、\nこの他にもざっと十数個存在しますわ。: By the way, there are roughly a dozen or so other structures with the same name.
m500527.ふふ、どう転んでも帝国の国威発揚になるのだから、\n気軽に全力でぼっこぼこにして:
Heh. No matter how it turns out, it serves to promote the empire's prestige.
So go ahead and beat them to a pulp without holding back.
m500527.ふむふむ、つまりこの要塞が、\nベラート伯爵――元伯爵の最高傑作だということね。: I see. So this fortress is the magnum opus of the Count of Belart—well, the former Count.
m500527.べらどんなさまー！\nてーこく軍にまけるなー！:
Lady Belladonna!
Don't lose to the Imperial Army!
m500527.イルヴィ、次に帝国とやり合うときには参考にしようぞ。: Irvit, let's keep that in mind for when we face the empire next time.
m500527.ベラドンナ、そんな情けない顔は見せないように。\n領民はあなたを信じてついてくる:
Belladonna, don't look so dejected.
The people are following you because they trust you.
m500527.一度は剣を向けあった仲だが、\nこれより先は、共に戦う仲間となる者たちだ。:
We may have drawn our swords against each other,
but from now on, you are comrades who will fight together.
m500527.勝たなくてもよろしいんですの？: So it's okay if we don't win?
m500527.勝敗ではなく、良い戦いをすることを心がけるのだ。: Focus on fighting a good battle, not just on winning.
m500527.否、これはいわばひとつの通過儀礼。\nベラドンナよ、お前が領主となるための儀式な:
No. This is, in a sense, a rite of passage.
Belladonna, it is the ritual for you to become the lord.
m500527.外部からむしり取り、自領の民に建築という仕事を斡旋し、\n経済を回しながら己の身:
Siphoning resources from outside, providing construction jobs to his own people,
keeping the economy moving while building a fortress to protect himself.
m500527.帝国軍なんざやっちまえー！\nベラート様！ 祝勝会はうちの酒場で頼みますぞー！:
Take down that Imperial Army—!
Lord Belart! We're holding the victory party at my tavern, so don't you dare miss it—!
m500527.我が伯爵領では、その代の最も偉大な建築や発明に、\n当主の名を冠するのが伝統にな: In our county, it is tradition to name the greatest architectural or technological achievements of an era after the lord in charge.
m500527.我が伯爵領の誇る最強の盾、\nベラート要塞が如何に堅牢であるか、\n皆さまにお披:
I'll show you just how impenetrable Belart Fortress is,
the strongest shield our county has to offer!
m500527.承知しましたわ父様！\nこのベラドンナ、最高の戦いをやり遂げますわよ！:
Understood, Father!
This Belladonna will deliver the finest battle of her life!
m500527.要塞に自分の名前を付けるとは、\nなんという自己顕示欲……。:
To name a fortress after yourself…
What an ego trip.
m500527.金が！ 利権が！ 向こうからやってくるのだ！: Money! Profits! They'll come running to us!
m500527.（アンジェリーネ様、\nやけにベラドンナさんのこと気にかけてますね）:
(Lady Angeline,
you seem unusually concerned about Miss Belladonna.)
m500527.（現状、伯爵領は厳しい立ち位置にあるのです。\n他の貴族が下手に手出しできないよ:
(As things stand, the Count's territory is in a delicate position.
By showing that she is Lady Angeline's favorite,
she ensures that other nobles won't dare interfere.)
